dossierId.description: Identifies the dossier ID where the matching was performed.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the matching was performed.

matchResult.description: Lists the fields that were matched between the source and target (ex: "firstName", "lastName", "dateOfBirth)".

sourceNormalized.description: Value string after the normalization is applied.

targetNormalized.description: Value string after the normalization is applied.

editDistance.description: Levenshtein distance between normalized values of source and target. Will be greater than 0 only if exactMatch = false.

error.description: (Exists only if an error occurred while performing match) Indicates why this field wasn't matched.

exactMatch.description: True if values of source and data fully match, false otherwise. For more details on how to perform matching, see the integration documentation.

partialMatch.description: True if values of source and data match partially, false otherwise. For more details on how to perform matching, see the integration documentation.

processId.description:
Use only if dataNode is not `userData`.
The ID of the process that contains the data used for matching.

dataNode.description:
Identifies the data node to be used as source/target data for the matching. This data node can be:
  • `userData` in the dossier: In this case you can simply omit `processId` in this request.
  • A data node from a process: It can be `finalResult`' for `onfido` processes. In this case you must also send `processId` in this request. The possible data nodes that can be used from each process depend on the provider of that process.
For more details on how to perform matching, see the integration documentation.

updatedAt.description: The date/time (ISO-8601 with UTC: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ) the match was executed. This field is returned only in the response.
